description: An Imperial plum floor-length court gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted opaque bodice and elbow sleeves. Rich gold woven borders and a cream patterned central panel decorate the neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. Small round jeweled clasps fasten the upper straps and waist. A cream wrap with plum-gold borders rests along the arms, while a small pendant necklace, bracelets, rings and decorated gold flats add restrained ornament.
